ChopChop downloads the official engine executable directly from its upstream
release when the user installs or updates it. The engine is stored in the
application data directory and runs as a separate process. Its code signature
is replaced locally with an ad-hoc signature with sandbox inheritance
entitlements; executable code is unchanged.

The app and release downloads contain no engine executable or engine source
archive. Engine binaries and source are available from the upstream project.
See Aria2Next-COPYING.txt for the license text, and upstream source for the
engine's libraries and their notices.
